units: Nidd. 33ᵃ וכל ר׳ הוא and the word kol (Lev. XV, 4) is an amplification (and not a specification, פרט).
Zeb. 8ᵇ לזבח ר׳ הוא the word l’zebaḥ (Lev. III, 6) is merely an amplification (and not a generalization כלל).
<cite ref="Shevuot 25b:5">Shebu. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>דמר׳ דקראי אתו</he> which are derived from the amplification of Scriptural expressions, i.e. which are only implied, not explicitly stated.

<cite ref="Yoma 6a:13">Yoma 6ᵃ</cite> <he>נדה וכל דאתי מר׳</he> the menstruant and all that is implied (all persons made unclean by contact with her); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="T00587"><he>רִיבּוּיֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="T00586"><he>רִבּ׳</he></cite>.
